verdict.line: You lose if Camille chains Hookshot into Ultimatum between levels 6-8 before your tank items land; you win if you survive to 9 and let Sunfire Aegis and Ground Slam's armor scaling take over.

brief.thesis: Camille's power is front-loaded into a level 6-8 Hookshot-into-Ultimatum all-in, while Malphite's Granite Shield only recharges if he hasn't been hit recently and Ground Slam's attack-speed cut directly punishes her auto-reset pattern. The matchup is even because each side has a short window the other can simply dodge rather than fight through.

theirWindow.what: Her passive shield is already up from the leap and she'll follow with an empowered Q (Precision Protocol) auto or Tactical Sweep's outer-cone slow. Don't trade back into this; disengage and let Granite Shield recharge before you re-enter.

yourWindow.when: When her E and Q are both on cooldown
yourWindow.what: Activate W (Brutal Strikes) for the Armor/AD buff, step in and use E (Ground Slam) to cut her attack speed, then Q (Seismic Shard) to slow her if she tries to walk away. This is the only window she can't answer with a reset.

powerCurve.note: Your Q (625 range) outpokes her Q (325 range)
Hookshot-Q combo online before your W
Ultimatum turns her E into a hard all-in
R becomes a teamfight pick, full tank core

start.why: 55.2% win rate over 252 games; the on-hit damage reduction and regen directly blunt a matchup built on repeated Camille autos and Q trades.

boots.why: 51.4% win rate, 81.4% pick rate; reduces incoming basic attack damage, which is most of what Camille deals to you.

core.why: First item in the highest-winrate path (62% over 108 games); gives HP and sustained AoE damage to punish her for standing near you.
Armor directly scales Ground Slam's damage and shreds her through-the-fight healing from Tactical Sweep.
Attack speed slow stacks with your E's attack-speed reduction to neuter her Precision Protocol-reset damage output.

situational.when: the enemy team is stacking magic damage alongside Camille's Ultimatum bonus magic damage
the game goes long and you need mixed resistances for extended teamfights
camille is leaning on tactical sweep's heal to win extended trades

runes.keystoneWhy: 52.9% measured win rate on this page; procs off your first auto per trade window, sustaining you through her poke and rewarding the same short, deliberate trades that beat her auto-reset pattern.

summoners.why: Flash+Teleport is the standard pick (74.3% pick rate, 48.9% win rate) and lets you scale into your level 9-13 power spike without giving up map presence; Flash+Ignite (52% win rate) is the stronger alternative if you want to press your measured solo-kill advantage early.

playing.title: Poke at max Q range pre-6
playing.detail: Seismic Shard's 625 range beats Camille's 325-range Q outright before level 6; chip her without ever entering her auto-attack range.

playing.title: Don't trade right after her E lands
playing.detail: The moment Hookshot's knockup connects her passive shield is active and a follow-up Q or Tactical Sweep is coming; back off and let Granite Shield recharge instead.

playing.title: Hold R through her 6-8 all-in window
playing.detail: Save Unstoppable Force to punish or disrupt her Hookshot-into-Ultimatum engage rather than initiating into it yourself.

playing.title: Pop W before committing to autos
playing.detail: Brutal Strikes' Armor/Attack Damage buff and splash damage wins straight auto-trades once it's up on its 14s cooldown; activate it the instant she commits.

playing.title: Use E to blunt her auto pressure
playing.detail: Ground Slam's attack-speed reduction directly counters the extra autos her Precision Protocol resets are built around.

playing.title: Freeze the wave past level 9
playing.detail: Once Sunfire Aegis and Thornmail are online, Ground Slam's armor-scaled damage flips trades in your favor; make her overextend to contest the wave.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, rune pages, and all win-rate/pick-rate figures are measured from current-patch games; the trade timing, cooldown reads, and power-spike sequencing are this brief's own tactical analysis.

stats.opponentTip: Use your [Q] to poke Camille. You will have the upper hand in lane sustain if you manage to dodger her (W).
